text.p: New Zealand test batsman Nathan Astle has signed for Nottinghamshire to fill their overseas vacancy, the English county announced on Tuesday.
The 25-year-old from Canterbury is to play for Notts for the remainder of the season after their officials secured his release from Lancashire League club Accrington.
Astle will be registered in time to make his debut in the four-day county championship match against Northamptonshire at Northampton starting on Wednesday.
He replaces Pakistan fast bowler Mohammad Zahid whose contract was terminated last week because he has a stress fracture of the back.
Notts gained special clearance from the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) registration committee to recruit a replacement because Zahid had not played for them since his arrival last month.
